notes: Added Organize Pages with drag-and-drop widget placement and multi-page support.
Added Advanced Notes to mix text and checkboxes in a single entry using Shift + Enter.
Added a Cleanup menu to Notes & Tasks settings to easily clear tasks or notes.
Introduced the Counters widget to track days since or until events and habits.
Introduced the Progresses widget to track multi-step goals with visual progress bars.
Added a new Golden accent color theme.
Pomodoro timers and tasks now sync automatically across all open tabs.
Added a mini-timer to the header to track active Pomodoro sessions from any page.
Refined the Liquid Glass design for a cleaner, more balanced appearance.
Added automatic daily update checks to notify you of new releases.
Updated the extension icon with a fresh new design.
Replaced the default toast library with a custom Toaster that blends seamlessly with the Liquid Glass design.
Revamped Data Backup & Restore with a cleaner UI and faster performance.
Backup files now automatically include the date and time in the filename.
Overhauled search suggestions for instant results and a smoother typing experience.
